m. (-कः)
A mountain, or rock in the sea between the southern end of the Peninsula and Laṅkā.
E.
मेनका the wife of Himāla, and अण् aff. of descent, being in mythology her son.

f. (-सा)
The goddess DURGĀ as PĀRVATĪ.
E.
मैनाक as above, and स्वसृ sister.

m. (-कः)
A fisherman.
E.
मीन a fish, and ठन् aff.

m. (-न्दः)
The name of a demon killed by VIṢṆU.

m. (-हा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
मैन्द as above, and हन् destroyer.
